bio.text: Dave Bronson is a Republican candidate for governor of Alaska in 2026.
He was elected mayor of Anchorage in 2021, served one term, and lost re-election in 2024 to Suzanne LaFrance.
In January 2025 Gov. Mike Dunleavy appointed him to manage Ted Stevens Anchorage International Airport; he announced his resignation from that job in August 2025.
The Alaska Beacon describes him as an experienced pilot.

sources.title: Former Anchorage Mayor Dave Bronson announces run for Alaska governor
